GET /api/historical-data/status.response: Returns status: operational, storage stats, api_configured: true

GET /api/historical-data/api/daily/{coin.response: Returns OHLCV data with timestamp, date, open, high, low, close, volume_from, volume_to

POST /api/historical-data/download/singl.response: Downloads and stores coin history, returns records_stored count

POST /api/historical-data/download/start.response: Starts background batch download with progress tracking

GET /api/historical-data/stats.response: Returns total_coins: 12, total_records: 42021, coins array with date ranges

GET /api/historical-data/coin/{coin_symb.response: Returns stored OHLCV data for coin, 404 for non-existent

POST /api/gems/train-ohlcv.response: Starts OHLCV-based AI training in background

GET /api/gems/deep-training-status.response: Returns training progress, metrics, patterns discovered
